---
name: Translation
about: A mistake or a stiff sentence in the French, German or Spanish documents
labels: translation
---

## Which file and which language

For example `docs/de-DE/OPERATOR_GUIDE.md`, section 5.

## The sentence as it stands

Quote it.

## What is wrong

A wrong word, a mistranslation of the English, a typography rule of the language, a sentence that
reads as a translation.

## Your proposal

The sentence as you would write it. The commands and the code blocks stay as in the English
source; only the prose changes.
